  .fw-product-showcase .fw-tcc-tabs {

    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  /* ===== Panel surface (black rounded card) ===== */
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] {
    --product-showcase-panel-content-gutter: 12px;
    --product-showcase-panel-padding-top: 64px;
    --product-showcase-panel-padding-bottom: 64px;
    --product-showcase-panel-padding-left: 64px;
    --product-showcase-panel-title-to-cta-gap: 40px;
    /* Min gap between CTA and metric/chips when the flex spacer collapses on short panels.
       Metrics pin to the content bottom via margin-top: auto (not a fixed 170px offset), so
       tall titles no longer push past padding-bottom / panel max-height. */
    --product-showcase-panel-metric-min-gap: 24px;
    --product-showcase-panel-min-height: 675px;
    --product-showcase-panel-max-height: 720px;
    --product-showcase-panel-media-content-gap: 72px;
    /* Fixed breathing room between the asset and the panel edges. Right + bottom are
       always honored; top is a MIN margin (asset is bottom-right anchored, so the top
       gap grows when the asset is shorter than the available height). */
    --product-showcase-panel-media-inset: 32px;
    /* Left keep-out zone on the asset, toward the content column. This guarantees a gap
       between the pills/metric and a column-filling asset regardless of aspect ratio,
       on top of the grid column gap (it does not shrink narrower portrait assets, which
       already sit clear of the left edge). */
    --product-showcase-panel-media-gap-left: 32px;
    /* Corner radius on the media asset itself (12px tablet/laptop/desktop, 8px mobile). */
    --product-showcase-panel-media-radius: 12px;
    background: #000000;
    border-radius: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin-inline: auto;
    min-height: var(--product-showcase-panel-min-height, 675px);
    padding: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;

  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] .fw-carousel__track {
    padding-left: 0 !important;
    padding-right: 0 !important;
  }

  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] > div,
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] > div > div,
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] .fw-section,
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] .fw-section > div,
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] .fw-carousel__viewport,
  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] .fw-carousel__track,

    flex: 1 1 auto;

    max-width: 100%;
    min-height: var(--product-showcase-panel-min-height, 675px);

  .fw-product-showcase [data-toggle-panel-surface] > div > div {
